title: 手机形态之争升级：OPPO、vivo集体跟进，阔直板将成下一种主流形态？
content: Chinese smartphone manufacturers like Huawei, OPPO, and vivo are developing "wide-slab" phones featuring broader 16:9 screens. Following successful initial sales of Huawei’s models, these companies aim to create a new market segment distinct from traditional slender designs. While wide screens improve video viewing and multitasking efficiency, they present challenges such as one-hand usability and app optimization. Although potentially more affordable and accessible than foldables, the form factor’s success remains unproven. Future adoption depends on broader industry participation, cost reduction, and the resolution of software compatibility and ergonomic issues.
